Sir/Madam, 
 
We write further to our letter of even no. dated 04.08.2026 regarding Conference Call [Con 
Call] for Financial Results of the Company for Q1 (FY 2026-27) and inform that the Audio 
Recording of the said Con Call [dated 10.08.2026] has been uploaded on our website as 
detailed hereunder: 
 
www.oil-india.com          Investors              Investor Services          Analysts / Investors Meet    
Audio recordings of the Analysts' and Investors' Call on 10th August, 2026 
 
Weblink: https://www.oil-india.com/files/2026-08/10046275.mp3 
 
We confirm that no Unpublished Price Sensitive Information (UPSI) was shared/discussed 
during the call. 
 
List of Management Attendees: 
 
1. Shri Saloma Yomdo, Director (E&D) 
2. Shri Abhijit Majumder, Director (Finance) 
3. Shri Trailukya Borgohain, Director (Operations) 
4. Shri Bhaskar Jyoti Phukan, MD (NRL) 
5. Shri Ajaya Kumar Sahoo, ED (CS) 
6. Shri Abhijit Das, CGM (F&A) 
 
This is for your information & records please. 
 
Thanking you, 
Yours faithfully, 
For Oil India Limited 
 
 
 
A.K. Sahoo 
Company Secretary &  
Compliance Officer
